_why: CURE WOUNDS, cast by a bard in the Squad Test so there is an ally to reach. The Combat Skald preset keeps its own spells and its fourth slot is swapped to Cure Wounds, with the book flags swapped alongside it (a preset writes slots directly and then runs prepare_auto_fill, so prepare_count would otherwise correctly drop a carried spell the book no longer holds). The Dev Hub refills HP before every fight, so there is nothing to cure until somebody is hurt: the script stands still for two rounds and lets the guards do the wounding. A SEED rather than forced rolls, because forced-high rolls kill a level 1 bard in one round and forced-low rolls mean nothing ever lands. Expect: the option costs an ACTION, not a bonus action; a bard slot spent; 2d8 + Charisma restored. It is Touch, so combat_friendly_reach is set to 0 at the call site and an ally standing further off is refused by name instead of the option quietly vanishing.
